//: Phase 4 — syntax-only gate for the frontend. Run from frontend/: tsconfig.syntax.json parses every src/**/*.js|jsx with the TypeScript parser (checkJs off, so only SYNTAX is enforced). It catches the two failure modes that broke the Vercel build at commit 3bd29c4: duplicate top-level declarations and malformed JSX — both of which @babel/parser and `node --check` accepted.
